title: El Nino watch: Nino 3.4 reaches +2.30 in Oct 2026
detail: Past El Nino dry seasons (2002, 2006, 2015, 2019, 2023) produced the largest fire and haze spikes in this record. Expect elevated fire risk in the Aug-Oct dry season.
